hypotheses.justification: The proof uses this instance only in `exists_algebra_finiteType fX (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) hU`, which produces some K-algebra structure on Γ(X, h⁻¹ᵁ V) of finite type. The conclusion does not mention fX. `height_comap_eq` takes `[Algebra k A] [Algebra k B] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k B]` as independent instances and does not need φ to be a k-algebra map, so any morphism X → Spec K that is locally of finite type works. `h ≫ fY` is one: Mathlib has the instance `[IsFinite f] : LocallyOfFiniteType f` (Morphisms/Finite.lean, line 121) and `locallyOfFiniteType_comp` (Morphisms/FiniteType.lean, line 63). Replacing `fX` with `(h ≫ fY)` in that call proves the theorem without the hypothesis. The statement is unchanged; fX remains as an unused argument.
